name: Binis
kurzbeschreibung: Binis in Tirol Discover the unique charm of Tirol with its traditional Binis – the iconic wooden clogs that have been handcrafted for generations.
beschreibung: Binis in Innsbruck is a cozy pub with an authentic atmosphere and genuine local character. A popular neighborhood spot, it welcomes guests with freshly tapped beers, regional wines, and tasty bar snacks. The laid-back interior and friendly staff make it easy to strike up a conversation and unwind after a busy day. An excellent address for a casual drink and friendly banter in Innsbruck.
